entities.summary: Elias White Mutale was a Zambian Catholic prelate, who was the Archbishop of the Archdiocese of Kasama, in Zambia. He was appointed Archbishops of Kasama on 17 September 1973 by Pope Paul VI. He died as Archbishop of Kasama on 12 February 1990, in a road traffic accident in Lusaka, Zambia's capital city. For a period of two years from 1971 until 1973, he was the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Mansa, a position he was appointed to by Pope Paul VI, on 3 July 1971. Father Elias White Mutale was consecrated bishop and installed on 12 September 1971.
